title: Latest Quantum Error Correction Developments
summary: ONEX framework achieves up to 42.1x speedup in quantum error correction compilation for neutral atom arrays scaling to 2,500 qubits using qLDPC codes and SMT optimization.

items.title: ONEX Framework
items.subtitle: Quantum Error Correction Accelerator
items.body: New framework simplifies synthesis of physical plans for quantum error correction by decomposing 2D planning into 1D problems using SMT encoding. Achieves 3.7x-42.1x speedup over existing methods.

items.title: Research Team
items.subtitle: Lead Investigator
items.body: Adrian Liu at UCLA with collaborators from Harvard University. Focus on qLDPC codes for neutral atom arrays.

items.title: Code Architecture
items.subtitle: qLDPC Implementation
items.body: Quantum low-density parity-check codes enable connections between non-adjacent qubits via physical atom movement, essential for fault-tolerant computation.
